HOW TO READ THIS BOARD · three kinds of number, three looks, each with its own spectrum · the same everywhere on the site
HOW OFTEN · a share or a tendency. Blue, deeper the more unusual. Never good or bad.
HOW MANY · volume: plays, dropbacks, carries, targets. Grey. Set by game state.
HOW WELL · ADJUSTED · quality with the schedule removed. Bright ramp. Read first.
HOW WELL · RAW · quality as it happened, schedule included. Same ramp, muted, dotted edge, with its games. Weigh it by the games and who they were against.
A rank always carries its word: 0–24 WEAK · 25–39 BELOW · 40–59 AVERAGE · 60–74 ABOVE · 75–100 STRONG. A count under the floor prints yellow and takes no color. When a raw figure and its adjusted figure sit in different bands, the row says so.
